domain: hammer-like design: adjusting a brittle tile in an adhesive bed
epistemic_status: Synthetic hypothetical proposals and predictions only; no real tile, adhesive, or equipment is supplied.

case.valued_outcome: Correct a small tile-height mismatch without creating an edge chip.
hard_constraints: Adjustment must use a hand-held device
resources: Tile and bed properties are unspecified
A hypothetical resilient contact pad is proposed
A thermal source is not supplied

raw_candidates.claim: A broad resilient tapping face may lower the tile without a concentrated edge load.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: The pad is predicted to spread force across the face while repeated impulses move the bed.
raw_candidates.discriminator: The source predicts fewer chips than a narrow face, but gives no prediction about relative adjustment time. Any chip or persistent height mismatch defeats adequacy.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: compare chip occurrence and height change on sacrificial matched bed conditions.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Required pad stiffness and sensitivity to bed curing are unknown.

raw_candidates.claim: Warming the bed before tapping might reduce the impulse required.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: The proposal predicts that a changed adhesive response would permit movement at lower loading.
raw_candidates.discriminator: It predicts easier adjustment than broad-pad tapping only when the adhesive responds reversibly to warmth. No reduction in required impulse defeats the proposed advantage.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only if the no-heating constraint is explicitly relaxed: compare warmed and ambient sacrificial beds.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Requires explicit relaxation of no heating; adhesive response and resulting bond integrity remain unknown.

raw_candidates.claim: A frame-mounted static press might adjust height without repeated impacts.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Sustained distributed force is predicted to move the bed gradually.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Rejected for requiring a fixed frame instead of a hand-held device. It might still chip the tile; absence of impacts does not establish safety.
raw_candidates.probe: Parked; a separate surrogate study could investigate cracking without establishing in-case fit.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Crack risk, required load, and adjustment precision remain unresolved.
